title: Insights on the synergistic effects of glycyrrhetinic acid and isoliquiritigenin on HMGB1-induced inflammation by multi-spectroscopic and molecular docking studies.
authors: Jiang, Xuewa; Yi, Shaoyan; Shen, Pingping; Raj, Richa; Zhang, Jian; Ge, Haixia
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多光谱和分子对接研究甘草酸与异甘草素与HMGB1蛋白的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Chronic low-grade inflammation, driven by elevated levels of circulating high mobility group box1 (HMGB1), plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of multiple chronic diseases. Glycyrrhetinic acid (GA) and isoliquiritigenin (ISL) are representative metabolites in licorice, exhibit potent regulatory effects on HMGB1-mediated chronic inflammation. In this research, we investigated the interactions of GA and ISL with HMGB1 using multi-spectroscopy, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), and molecular docking. Fluorescence spectroscopy revealed that GA or ISL binds to HMGB1, leading to static fluorescence quenching of the protein. Additionally, the binding of GA or ISL altered the microenvironment of tryptophan and decreased the alpha-helix content of HMGB1 to varying extents. Dynamic light scattering (DLS) showed that GA induced aggregation of the HMGB1 complex into large particles, while ISL reduced the particle size of HMGB1. SPR analysis confirmed that GA and ISL bound reversibly to HMGB1 with K(d) values of 53.0 +/- 3.6 and 16.3 +/- 0.5 muM, respectively. Molecular docking further elucidated the binding modes and sites of GA and ISL on HMGB1, showing that GA binds to the B-box and ISL binds to the A-box of HMGB1, with hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions as the primary driving forces. Isobologram analysis demonstrated that the combination of GA and ISL exhibited a significant synergistic inhibitory effect on HMGB1-induced inflammation on RAW264.7 cells, with an optimal combination ratio of 1:1. This study reveals that GA and ISL synergistically exert anti-inflammatory effect by modulating HMGB1 conformation, offering new insights into licorice extracts for preventing chronic inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 由循环高水平高迁移率族蛋白1（HMGB1）驱动的慢性低度炎症，在多种慢性疾病的发病机制中起着关键作用。甘草次酸（GA）和异甘草素（ISL）是甘草中的代表性代谢物，对HMGB1介导的慢性炎症表现出显著的调节作用。在本研究中，我们利用多光谱法、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和分子对接技术，探讨了GA和ISL与HMGB1的相互作用。荧光光谱显示，GA或ISL与HMGB1结合，导致蛋白质的静态荧光猝灭。此外，GA或ISL的结合改变了色氨酸的微环境，并不同程度地降低了HMGB1的α-螺旋含量。动态光散射（DLS）表明，GA诱导HMGB1复合物聚集形成大颗粒，而ISL则减小了HMGB1的粒径。SPR分析证实，GA和ISL可逆地结合HMGB1，其解离常数（K(d)）值分别为53.0 ± 3.6和16.3 ± 0.5 μM。分子对接进一步阐明了GA和ISL在HMGB1上的结合模式和位点，显示GA结合于B-box，ISL结合于A-box，氢键和疏水相互作用是主要驱动力。等效应图分析表明，GA和ISL的组合对RAW264.7细胞上HMGB1诱导的炎症表现出显著的协同抑制作用，最佳组合比例为1:1。本研究揭示，GA和ISL通过调节HMGB1构象协同发挥抗炎作用，为甘草提取物预防慢性炎症性疾病提供了新见解。
